questions.question: Which article of the Indian Constitution deals with the establishment and organisation of the State Public Service Commission?
questions.explanation: Article 153 deals with the establishment and organisation of the State Public Service Commission.

questions.question: Under the Panchayat (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996, which one of the following is not a power of the Gram Sabha?
options: To manage and conserve common property resources
To exercise self-governance in respect of land and forests
To approve plans for development and implementation
To decide on the allocation of developmental funds
questions.explanation: The Gram Sabha does not directly decide on the allocation of developmental funds.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a feature of the Sixth Schedule of the Indian Constitution?
options: Creation of autonomous districts in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram
Creation of Autonomous Administrative Units in Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram
Creation of the Planning Board for Tribal Areas
questions.explanation: The Planning Board is not a part of the Sixth Schedule.

questions.question: The Panchayats (Extension to Scheduled Areas) Act, 1996, was enacted by the Parliament of India for the benefit of which region?
options: Hilly and tribal areas of West Bengal
Hilly and tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in urban areas
Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes in rural areas
questions.explanation: The Act was enacted for the hilly and tribal areas of Assam, Meghalaya, Tripura, and Mizoram.

questions.question: Which of the following is a provision of the West Bengal Panchayats Act, 1973?
options: Gram Panchayat can have maximum 30 members
Gram Panchayat can have maximum 50 members
Gram Panchayat can have maximum 35 members
Gram Panchayat can have maximum 40 members
questions.explanation: The West Bengal Panchayats Act, 1973, allows a Gram Panchayat to have a maximum of 40 members.

questions.question: The River Hooghly is the primary distributary of which major river in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: It is the main distributary of the Ganga River.

questions.question: Which of the following mountain ranges lies in the northern part of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: It is a part of the Himalayan mountain range in India.

questions.question: The Sundarbans National Park is located in which district of West Bengal?
questions.explanation: It is a part of the South 24 Parganas district.

questions.question: Which of the following rivers in West Bengal is known for its extensive delta system?
questions.explanation: It is the primary distributary of the Ganga River.

questions.question: The Darjeeling Himalayan Railway passes through which hill station in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: It is a popular hill station in the state.

questions.question: The Mamata Banerjee-led TMC government in West Bengal recently launched a new initiative called 'Duare Raajyabhasha' to promote which language?
questions.explanation: It aims to promote Bengali as the primary language.

questions.question: The West Bengal Government recently increased the minimum wage for unskilled workers to Rs. ______ per day.
questions.explanation: The increase aims to support the state's informal workforce.

questions.question: The Kolkata Metro Rail Corporation has recently announced plans to extend the Line 3 of the Kolkata Metro to which area?
questions.explanation: The extension aims to enhance connectivity in the northern parts of Kolkata.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has launched a new scheme to provide financial assistance to farmers affected by which natural disaster?
questions.explanation: The scheme aims to support farmers affected by cyclone damage.

questions.question: The West Bengal government has recently announced plans to develop a new eco-tourism project in the Sundarbans region of which district?
questions.explanation: The project aims to promote sustainable tourism in the Sundarbans.

questions.question: Under which scheme, the West Bengal government aims to provide financial assistance to the poor and disadvantaged women for their socio-economic development?
questions.explanation: It is a conditional cash transfer scheme for girls.

questions.question: What is the primary objective of the 'Swasthya Sathi' scheme launched by the West Bengal government?
options: To provide cashless treatment to all
To provide health insurance to all
To provide free treatment to all below poverty line
questions.explanation: It provides health insurance to all residents of West Bengal.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a component of the 'Mukhya Mantri Gram Sadak Yojana' scheme in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: This scheme is actually included in the components.

questions.question: What is the main aim of the 'Deshapriya Park Flyover' project initiated by the West Bengal government?
options: To reduce traffic congestion in Kolkata
To increase the number of flyovers in Kolkata
To increase the parking facilities in Kolkata
questions.explanation: It aims to reduce traffic congestion in Kolkata.

questions.question: Which of the following schemes provides assistance to the small and medium entrepreneurs in West Bengal?
questions.explanation: It provides financial assistance to small and medium entrepreneurs.

questions.question: A person deposits ₹15,000 in a bank account which accrues a simple interest of 6% per annum for 2 years. What is the amount at the end of the 2nd year?
questions.explanation: Using the simple interest formula I = (P * R * T) / 100.

questions.question: What is the compound interest on ₹20,000 for 3 years at the rate of 4% per annum compounded annually?
questions.explanation: Using the compound interest formula A = P(1 + R/100)^n.

questions.question: A sum of money is lent at 8% per annum for 5 years. If the simple interest accrued is ₹18,000, what is the principal amount?
questions.explanation: Rearranging the simple interest formula to find the principal amount.

questions.question: If ₹5,000 is borrowed at 5% per annum for 2 years compounded quarterly, what is the amount at the end of the 2nd year?
questions.explanation: Using the compound interest formula A = P(1 + R/n)^(n*T).

questions.question: What is the difference between compound interest and simple interest on ₹15,000 for 2 years at the rate of 9% per annum?
questions.explanation: Calculating the interest using both formulae and finding the difference.

questions.question: Kalyan is the son of Ashok. Ashok is the son of whom?
questions.explanation: Ashok's father is Kalyan's grandfather.

questions.question: If a woman has a son, then which of the following can be her sister?
questions.explanation: A woman's husband's mother is her mother-in-law.

questions.question: A is the mother of B. B is the mother of C. Who is the father of B?
questions.explanation: Since B is married, B's husband is the father of B.

questions.question: If a person has only two children, both of whom are daughters, then which of the following can be the father's sister?
questions.explanation: The father's sister is the person's paternal aunt.

questions.question: A is the mother of B. B is the daughter of C. If D is the wife of C, then who is the mother-in-law of D?
questions.explanation: D's husband's mother is D's mother-in-law.

questions.question: A person is facing North direction and walks 100 meters. He then turns 90 degrees to the right and walks 200 meters. He then turns 90 degrees to the right and walks 100 meters. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: As he turned 90 degrees to the right twice, he is facing in the original direction.

questions.question: A person is standing at a point P in Kolkata. He moves 20 meters towards South, then 15 meters towards West, then 20 meters towards North, and finally 10 meters towards East. Which direction is point P now from the starting point?
questions.explanation: The net displacement is 5 meters towards South and 10 meters towards East.

questions.question: A person is facing West direction and turns 135 degrees to the right. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.explanation: When you turn 135 degrees to the right from West, you are facing South-East.

questions.question: A man is standing at a point P in Darjeeling. He walks 250 meters towards North and then 150 meters towards West. Which direction will he take to reach the starting point?
questions.explanation: To reach the starting point, he will have to move in a direction opposite to his current direction.

questions.question: A person is standing at a point P and finds that the sun is at his back. Which direction is he facing?
questions.explanation: The sun is at his back, so he is facing North.

questions.question: Find the missing term in the series: 2, 6, 12, 20, 30, ?
questions.explanation: The pattern is an increase of 4, 6, 8, and 10.

questions.question: In the series: A, O, Q, U, ?, the next letter is:
questions.explanation: The pattern is adding 2 letters in the alphabet.

questions.question: Find the missing term in the series: 2, 11, 26, ?, 61
questions.explanation: The pattern is adding consecutive multiples of 3 and 4.

questions.question: Which number should replace the question mark in the series: 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ?
questions.explanation: The pattern is adding consecutive integers.

questions.question: In the series: D, E, F, G, ?, the next letter is:
questions.explanation: The pattern is increasing the alphabet by one letter.
